contract.selection: bounded rev-list --all plus captured HEAD, then immutable full trees; no atomic refs snapshot claimed
contract.scopes: one per acquisition and commit; no cross-revision/repository, archive or symlink borrowing
contract.identity: private history selector contains commit; value fingerprint stays shared, location IDs differ
contract.git_views: --no-replace-objects and GIT_GRAFT_FILE=null device for opt-in component Git commands
contract.incomplete: shallow/malformed/missing objects and budget failures inhibit composite probes and baseline update
contract.unborn_history: complete empty history when no refs and symbolic HEAD; ignores working files

local.network: OS deny-network except localhost; owned Git/HTTP only

repository.network: OS deny-network except localhost; owned Git/HTTP only

default_repository.scope: local Git clone wrapper, owned Git objects and loopback org inventory only; no real remote repository or provider use

source_tests: separate complete trees, unchanged primary and working-copy disagreement
34 MiB repeated blob across two commits exceeds global 32 MiB cap
literal commit trees under replace refs and disk/environment graft views

development_finding.result: initial opt-in history prototype reused location ID across commits; new producer private IdentityPath separates revisions
